name: local-agent-mcp
description: Chat Unleashed: a local MCP server that lets ChatGPT Chat act on an Apple Silicon Mac, with shell, files, native macOS UI, browser control, durable tasks and deep iWork automation.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/index.js',0o755)"
scripts.smoke:all: node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/smoke-task.mjs && npm run smoke:logic --silent && node scripts/smoke-targets.mjs && node scripts/smoke-project.mjs && node scripts/smoke-portability.mjs
scripts.build:stress-fixtures: esbuild src/store.ts src/large-text.ts src/exec.ts src/coding.ts src/tasks.ts src/capacity.ts src/skills.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=.stress --log-level=warning
scripts.stress:all: npm run stress:scale --silent && npm run stress:http --silent && npm run stress:files --silent
scripts.validate:release: npm run build --silent && npm run check:public --silent && npm run smoke:all --silent && npm run stress:all --silent && npm run check:public --silent && npm run check:pack --silent && npm run test:updater --silent
scripts.install:local: npm run build && npm run deploy:local
